newsitem.title: GREECE: NAT'L BANK/GREECE HAS NO DEAL WITH FYROM BANK - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: NAT'L BANK/GREECE HAS NO DEAL WITH FYROM BANK - SOURCE.

text.p: Greece's largest commercial National Bank of Greece has reached no agreement with any bank in FYROM, a high-level National Bank official told Reuters.
"There is no truth in the report of daily 'Exousia' that National Bank bought a major stake in a major bank in FYROM," said the high-level official.

National Bank of Greece has expressed interest in strengthening its presence in the neighbouring country but clinched no deal to buy any bank in the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia, the high-level official said.

"We are interested in cooperating with banks in FYROM in line with the bank's strategy set out by our chairman Theodore Karatzas but there is no deal whatsoever," said the official. "Everything else is pure speculation."
A Greek delegation led by the state National Bank of Greece was in FYROM on Thursday and held talks with government officials and other officials, he said.
There was market talk that the state National Bank agreed to buy a 53 percent stake in FYROM's major bank, Stopanska Banka.
Shares of the state National Bank of Greece closed 5.83 percent higher to 32,200 drachmas on heavy volume of 82,587 shares today. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
